variants.title: Vernier callipers: diameter of a pendulum bob

variants.note: Half this diameter is added to the thread length to get the length of a simple pendulum.

variants.aim: Read the main scale and the vernier to measure the diameter of a pendulum bob (least count 0.1 mm).
